items.q: But anyway, they contacted me, Mr. Pascal, and said they wanted me to be

ctx.x: dancer. I was told that they were going to do her life, and it was on a New years Eve night, and what I used to do, I used to always get home for Christmas, you know. I wouldn't be away from home. I didn't -- I was home one time, away from my son at Christmastime, once, and I was never so miserable in my entire life. I was never so miserable, and I promised myself that I would never do that again, regardless of how much money, you know, it meant I would miss. I must spend Christmas, because I was used to this,…

But anyway, they contacted me, Mr. Pascal, and said they wanted me to be -- to do a number on this show, and it was going to be on a New Years Eve night. Well, on New Years Eve night some friends of mine were having a party or something, and you know, this was already arranged, for me to go to this party. I was looking forward to it, because working all the time you just didn't get a chance to do other things, you know, and I said, well, I'm going to be home, and I looked forward to going to this party.
